Wallen Assistant Professor of Business Administration Assistant Professor of Business Administration Read more Jonathan Wallen is an Assistant Professor of Finance in the Finance Unit and teaches Finance 1 to MBA students. Professor Wallen’s research centers on financial intermediation and its intersection with asset pricing, currency markets, industrial organization, and banking regulation. He studies the effects of frictions to financial intermediation on asset prices and risk premia. These frictions include bank capital regulations, debt overhang, and imperfect competition.
